summary: Initializes a D3D texture copy context: validates the surface-type parameter, creates source and destination surfaces via DirectXTextureSurfaceFactoryDispatchingFourCCCod, then runs a chain of surface copy/resampling/vertex-transfer methods (first success wins), releasing both surfaces through their vtable Release on every exit path.

operations.description: Zero the source and destination surface pointers (this+0x4, this+0x0) and store the surface-type parameter a6 into this+0x8.
Validate a6: the low word must be nonzero, at most 5, and the mask (a6 & 0xFFF00000) must be zero; on failure return -2005530516.
Write the flag (a6 & 0x80000) into the caller-supplied structure at offset a4+64.
Create the source surface via DirectXTextureSurfaceFactoryDispatchingFourCCCod(a4) and store the handle into this+0x4; a null result jumps to the shared cleanup path.
Create the destination surface via DirectXTextureSurfaceFactoryDispatchingFourCCCod(a5) and store the handle into this+0x0; a null result jumps to the shared cleanup path.
Call TextureCopyRealloc on the destination surface; only if its result is >= 0 does the transfer-method chain run.

Run the transfer-method chain (SurfacePixelCopy, MemoryAllocationWithVectorConstructor, sub_504731, Direct3DTextureResampling, COMInterfaceVectorProcessingMethod, MultiLevelBufferAllocationWithVectorOps, sub_5054EC, VertexBufferAllocationAndStageTransformation, sub_506003, sub_502F31); the first method returning >= 0 makes the chain succeed.
Set the result code: 0 when the chain succeeded, otherwise -2147467259 (generic failure).
Release the source surface by calling its vtable slot 0 (Release with argument 1) and clear this+0x4.
Release the destination surface by calling its vtable slot 0 (Release with argument 1) and clear this+0x0.

unresolved: Meaning of the surface type parameter a6 (range 1..5 with 0xFFF00000 excluded) and of the flag written to a4+64 is not established.
The transfer-method chain is 'first success wins' per the decompiled condition order; the individual method purposes are unknown.
The obj base in the destination release corresponds to the destination surface object pointed at by this+0x0.
